title: The Star Bowling
native_title: ザ・スター・ボーリング
overview: The Star Bowling is a 3D bowling game where the player competes against one of five real-life voice actresses. The main story mode has the player select a girl and play against them in multiple games; winning against each opponent will unlock video clips of that girl in a bonus gallery on the second disc. Various ball and lane variations are included, and there is also a two-player versus mode.
